title: vaultengine JSON-RPC 2.0 API
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio: one UTF-8 JSON message per line, in both directions. Params are by-name objects. The root schema accepts a single message or a batch.

index.build.summary: Create or incrementally update the index.

index.status.summary: Whether the index exists and is up to date.

vault.stats.summary: Summary numbers for the indexed vault.

notes.pick.summary: Fuzzy-find notes by title and alias.

note.get.summary: Properties, tags, headings, blocks and links in/out of one note.

vault.check.summary: Every violation of the format, per note, with line numbers.

vault.fix.summary: Repair missing mirrors and missing required headings (safe write path).

vault.coverage.summary: Sources nothing links to, and notes that cite no source.

note.new.summary: Create a note of a type; refused if it would add a violation.

note.link.summary: Relate note A to note B and write the mirror in B.

note.set.summary: Set a metadata value of a note.

note.ingest.summary: Turn a document into a note; nothing is written if it duplicates one.

search.query.summary: Search with text and structure; ranked hits with snippets, tag and folder counts.

note.preview.summary: A note's lines with a query's matches marked.

note.related.summary: Notes related to a note by links, text and tags, each with a reason.

links.suggest.summary: Pairs of notes that probably belong linked, with the evidence.

notes.suggest.summary: Missing notes worth writing, overlapping names, links meant for existing notes.

mentions.unlinked.summary: Plain-text mentions of note titles and aliases that are not links yet.

explore.run.summary: Explore from a note (or where to start): a section per lens, each result with its lens and evidence; remembered for explore.mark and explore.link.

explore.mark.summary: Keep, dismiss or clear results of the last explore.run (the memory, never the notes).

explore.kept.summary: What was kept from explore, with its lens and evidence.

explore.link.summary: A result (or two notes) made a link under See Also in both notes; dry run unless dry_run=false.

explore.unlink.summary: Undo explore.link: remove the See Also lines linking the two notes; dry run unless dry_run=false.

map.get.summary: The map: communities, topic pages, bridges, hubs and authorities; record=true saves a snapshot.

map.since.summary: What changed since a recorded map: gaps closed, communities formed or gone, missing notes written.

note.deepen.summary: Five lenses on one note: neighbourhood, cited together, same foundations, backbone, cluster.

vault.discover.summary: Discover lenses: hidden links, same roles, bridges, gaps, surprises, unwritten notes, a wander.

notes.explain.summary: How two notes relate, signal by signal, with the evidence.

embed.status.summary: How many notes have a cached vector for the configured model.

config.show.summary: Every engine setting, its value and where it came from.

reason.description: Why a 'changed' check looked at every note (the index needs a rebuild).
reason.title: Reason

checked.description: False: not changed itself, but affected by a changed or deleted note.
checked.title: Checked

clause.description: The clause as written in the query, e.g. reward, "reward hacking", a NEAR/3 b.
clause.title: Clause

term.description: For a word: the indexed word that matched (a close spelling when not exact).
term.title: Term

ConfigShowRequest.description: Every engine setting, its value and where it came from. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
ConfigShowRequest.title: ConfigShowRequest

unlinked.description: Sources no other note links to.
unlinked.title: Unlinked

a_to_b.description: Lines of a with a link to b.
a_to_b.title: A To B

titles_compared.description: [the document's title, the note's closest title]

content_overlap.description: Null when a text is too short to compare.
content_overlap.title: Content Overlap

EmbedStatusRequest.description: How many notes have a cached vector for the configured model. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
EmbedStatusRequest.title: EmbedStatusRequest

contribution.description: weight x value; the score is their sum.
contribution.title: Contribution

ref.description: '2.3': section 2, result 3 of this run; what explore.mark and explore.link take.
ref.title: Ref

kind.description: note: a note; pair: two notes not linked (a gap's joiners); link: a link that is there (surprise); missing: a missing note; community: a community or a pair of them.
kind.title: Kind

target.description: What it is about, as remembered: a path, 'a ↔ b', '[[name]]', 'community: …'.
target.title: Target

evidence.description: One line: why the lens found it, with the numbers it rests on.

notes.description: The notes it is about (vault paths).

link.description: The two notes explore.link would link; null when it is not two notes to link.

mark.description: Your earlier mark for this result from this start.

ref.description: A result of the last explore.run; or give a and b.

dry_run.description: True (the default): return the diff and write nothing.

ExploreLinkRequest.title: ExploreLinkRequest

status.description: written; refused (would add violations, nothing written); dry-run; unchanged.
status.title: Status

already.description: Parts of the request that were already so, e.g. an existing mirror.
already.title: Already

new_violations.description: Why a write was refused: violations it would add.

tolerated.title: Tolerated

recovered.description: Files restored from an interrupted earlier write.

notes.description: The two notes, as given or from the result.

kept.description: The result counted as a keep (a link made from a result).
kept.title: Kept

ExploreMarkRequest.title: ExploreMarkRequest

keep_rates.description: For the lenses marked here, over every start.
keep_rates.title: Keep Rates

note.title: Note

lenses.description: Null: engine.explore.lenses (or start_lenses without a note).
lenses.title: Lenses

fresh.description: Leave out what was seen or dismissed before from this start.

record.description: Remember the run: its results become refs for explore.mark/link, and count as seen.

refresh.description: Recompute the stored vault-wide numbers now.
refresh.title: Refresh

ExploreRunRequest.description: Explore from a note (or where to start): a section per lens, each result with its lens and evidence; remembered for explore.mark and explore.link. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
ExploreRunRequest.title: ExploreRunRequest

start.description: The start's path, '[[missing note]]', or null (proposals).

dry_run.description: True (the default): return the diff and write nothing.
dry_run.title: Dry Run
